facts.fact: Dal Mare 在船内剖杀七名孩子取血——预言确认他需要 Michele Cavaterra 的血
facts.anchor: Around him are the gutted bodies of seven children

facts.fact: 预言证实 Dal Mare 需要 Michele 的血
facts.anchor: he needs Michele Cavaterra’s blood

facts.fact: Pan 主显节乱局中他没带走 Michele，于是派 Wedge 去追踪
facts.anchor: To make up for it he has set Wedge on his tracks

facts.fact: 他更想策反 Cavaterra 全家而非杀害：那才是至高胜利与最甜的复仇
facts.anchor: he’d rather convert them to his cause—that is the triumph he seeks, the sweetest revenge

facts.fact: 他认定某种诗意：让 Stefano 之子释放他
facts.anchor: there’s a certain poetry in the fact it’ll be Stefano’s son that sets him free

facts.fact: 大橡树下的地窟要飞才能进，Giada 与 Wendy 不会飞
facts.anchor: There are no pulleys or hoists, you have to fly down, but Giada and Wendy don’t know how to do that

facts.fact: 河边更衣时 Wendy 忍不住看 Giada 紧实柔软的身体
facts.anchor: Wendy can’t help glancing at Giada—she has a tight, lithe body, a joy to behold

facts.fact: Giada 以劣质色情片腔调挑逗 Wendy 玩过界
facts.anchor: in a bad imitation of a porn actress

facts.fact: Wendy 笑着自摸后忽然不确定还是玩笑
facts.anchor: She puts a hand between her legs, onto the waxed skin, still joking around

facts.fact: 树影里 Peter 裸体自慰，毫无羞意地打招呼
facts.anchor: Hidden in the shadow of the trees, Peter Pan is naked. He strokes himself slowly, without a trace of embarrassment

facts.fact: 那滴液甜香异于人精——Wendy 领受了神的圣餐
facts.anchor: It has a sweet odour, different from human semen. Wendy accepts the sacrament of the god

facts.fact: 明明 Peter 还在远处岸上，Wendy 试图说服自己没发生，身体不信
facts.anchor: Maybe it didn’t really happen, Wendy tells herself, but her body doesn’t believe her

facts.fact: Filippo 在 Flesh 口吃、在 Enchantment 不口吃
facts.anchor: Filippo who stutters in Flesh, and never in Enchantment

facts.fact: 八岁的 Filippo 已是纯熟杀手，令 Giada 不安
facts.anchor: at eight years old he’s already an accomplished killer

facts.fact: Imaginary Enemies 游戏只禁召唤 Goku 与 Peter Pan
facts.anchor: The only enemies that cannot be invoked are Goku from Dragon Ball (the Twins are in agreement that he’s overpowered) and Peter Pan

facts.fact: Peter 拒绝让今晚的战斗毁掉今天
facts.anchor: I’m not going to let it ruin my day

facts.fact: Peter 以决断句式宣布今夜救回 Luisa 但不许再问
facts.anchor: I’ve decided,” Peter answers, “that Luisa will be saved tonight. That’s it.

facts.fact: 若 Giovanni 想现在就去，Peter 指海滩让他游过去
facts.anchor: Peter extends a hand towards the beach. “Swim.

facts.fact: Wendy 憋出的计划只有这一句
facts.anchor: the plan is: let’s take a troop of flying children to assault a pirate ship

facts.fact: 孩子们欢悦地以欢呼任命她为「崇高战略家」
facts.anchor: Peter Pan and the Lost Children, delighted, decide to appoint her Exalted Strategist by acclamation

facts.fact: 授职礼赠地图一张，是澳大利亚的
facts.anchor: this one is of Australia, but that’s a detail

facts.fact: Giovanni 说明岛不是「异世界」而是 Aspect
facts.anchor: I talked to Tinker Bell and Peter Pan about it. They call it an Aspect

facts.fact: Wendy 以手法比喻解释视角切换
facts.anchor: Neverland is a sleight-of-hand trick

facts.fact: Giovanni 纠正：我们在 Enchantment，这是真魔法
facts.anchor: We’re in Enchantment,” Giovanni corrects her. “It’s real magic.

facts.fact: Wendy 的定论：手法与魔法没有区别
facts.anchor: There’s no difference

facts.fact: Hook 独白：能航海者可在诸领域找到宝藏乃至自己
facts.anchor: anyone, man or god, who’s capable of sailing it may find treasures that shine in all the Aspects: find themselves, even

facts.fact: Hook 昨日望见 Stefano 与 Silvia 的火葬柴堆
facts.anchor: Yesterday he saw the funerary pyre for Stefano and Silvia

facts.fact: 二人共享一个「胆敢囚神者」的童年敌人（Barrie）
facts.anchor: who dared to imprison gods

facts.fact: Hook 自信即将摆脱纸与墨（原著）的束缚
facts.anchor: soon Hook will free himself from the power of paper and ink

facts.fact: 仙女是异教造物，畏惧基督教圣物
facts.anchor: The fairies, pagan creatures, are vulnerable to Christian symbols

facts.fact: 捕仙女的网出自西西里神父祝圣的渔护仪式
facts.anchor: This net was once blessed by a Sicilian priest, in a traditional rite used to protect fishermen

facts.fact: 圣网不伤皮肉，灼的是她的本性
facts.anchor: the blessed weave burns her very nature

facts.fact: Hook 携捕获跨入另一领域
facts.anchor: He grabs his prey and disappears into another Aspect

facts.fact: 兄妹童年在花园船腹的想象成真为可触摸之地
facts.anchor: They used to imagine it was full of pirates and they were part of the crew: they would never have thought that their imaginings, one day, would become tangible

facts.fact: 导师 Fatty/Smee 称 Dal Mare 早算准他们会被引到牢区
facts.anchor: He was sure that they’d send you here

facts.fact: 临死前 Luisa 的心事：有秘密本不该对他保持沉默
facts.anchor: There are secrets that she should have revealed to him: things too important for silence

facts.fact: 开门进来的不是 Giovanni 而是导师（他自称 Smee 或 Fatty，随领域改名）
facts.anchor: But her boyfriend doesn’t enter the cell—Fatty does, or Smee, whatever he calls himself in this Aspect

facts.fact: Smee 一剑穿透她右眼、刮上骨
facts.anchor: Luisa feels the metal pierce her right eye, scrape against bone

facts.fact: 叙述者对「不公平」的答句只三字：但事情就这样
facts.anchor: Perhaps not, but so it goes

facts.fact: 看见 Tinker Bell 持染血剑立于 Luisa 尸旁，Giovanni 嚎着扑上
facts.anchor: Giovanni attacks the fairy with a howl

facts.fact: 他抱她、合上她的眼、低语道别
facts.anchor: He closes her eyes, murmuring goodbye

facts.fact: 章末：只剩眼泪，别无他物
facts.anchor: All that’s left are tears, and nothing more
